{'text': 'Reports indicate that several new Apple products will be announced on October 13, including an upgraded Apple TV 4K. Below are two major upgrades rumoured for the new Apple TV.', 'type': 'text'}

{'text': '#1: Siri AI', 'type': 'text'}

{'text': 'When Apple first unveiled Siri AI in June this year, it was positioned as a cross-platform revolution, delivering a consistent experience regardless of which device you use.', 'type': 'text'}

{'text': 'The new Siri debuted on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and Vision Pro. But notably, no one has ever mentioned Siri AI coming to Apple TV or HomePod. And among all the OS 27 updates released last month, tvOS and HomePod software were the only two platforms that did not incorporate the new Siri.', 'type': 'text'}

{'text': 'However, this is about to change. Siri AI is reportedly set to be one of the headline features of the new Apple TV 4K.', 'type': 'text'}

{'text': "Based on Siri AI's performance on other platforms, this feature is bound to bring significant upgrades to tvOS users. Beyond smarter handling of TV shows and films, more accurate content recommendations, and the expected enhancement of the InSight feature, the new Siri can also answer general knowledge questions just like on other devices.", 'type': 'text'}

{'text': '#2: Upgrade from the current A15 Bionic to an A19-class chip', 'type': 'text'}

{'text': 'The Apple TV 4K has not been updated since 2022, with the current model using the A15 chip that first appeared in 2021.', 'type': 'text'}

{'text': 'But reports suggest the new Apple TV 4K launching next week will bring a major chip upgrade, featuring an A19 or A19 Pro chip.', 'type': 'text'}

{'text': 'Leaker Aaron Perris discovered a reference to a new hardware identifier in Apple code, labelled "AppleTV18,1". This "18,1" numbering scheme matches that of the iPhone 17 series, pointing to the use of an A19-class chip.', 'type': 'text'}

{'text': 'I estimate it will use the A19 Pro rather than the A19, because the latter does not support the customisable speech rate and tonal expression for Siri AI. Since Siri AI is a key feature of the new Apple TV, the A19 Pro seems to be the more logical choice.', 'type': 'text'}

{'text': 'Further reading: The new Apple TV 4K is on the way: four features launching soon', 'type': 'text'}

{'text': 'Will you be upgrading your Apple TV 4K? Why? Feel free to share in the comments section.', 'type': 'text'}
